rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: So that's the new bomber loaded with that 'Orange' thing they mentioned...
rows.display_text:
「So that's the new bomber loaded with
that 'Orange' thing they mentioned...」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: If it's a bomber, does that mean this Orange is a bomb?
rows.display_text:
「If it's a bomber, does that mean this
Orange is a bomb?」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Seems that way. They're about to run the drop test for it now, I'd guess.
rows.display_text:
「Seems that way. They're about to run
the drop test for it now, I'd guess.」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Whoa, hold on! Don't tell me we're... standing right where they're gonna drop the bomb!?
rows.display_text:
「Whoa, hold on! Don't tell me we're
standing right where they'll drop the
bomb!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Don't worry. The bombing site is somewhere else.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry. The bombing site is
somewhere else.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: We're to see that bomber off, then stand by here until further orders.
rows.display_text:
「We're to see that bomber off, then
stand by here until further orders.」

rows.speaker: Jaboli
rows.en: No contacts on radar either. Looks like this one's going to end without incident.
rows.display_text:
「No contacts on radar either. Looks like
this one's going to end without incident.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Seems the special advisor's worries were needless after all.
rows.display_text:
「Seems the special advisor's worries were
needless after all.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: ...Let's hope so...
rows.display_text: 「...Let's hope so...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Tch...! I psyched myself up for this sortie, and it's a total letdown.
rows.display_text:
「Tch...! I psyched myself up for this
sortie, and it's a total letdown.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Sweet, bro. That your new toy?
rows.display_text: 「Sweet, bro. That your new toy?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Damn right, bro. Behold, Beck the Great RX3...! A super machine to strike fear into all!
rows.display_text:
「Damn right, bro. Behold, Beck the Great
RX3...! A machine to strike fear into all!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What an over-the-top name...!
rows.display_text: 「What an over-the-top name...!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Tch-tch-tch... little lady. It's not just the name that's impressive. What's inside packs a punch too!
rows.display_text:
「Tch-tch-tch... little lady. It's not just
the name that impresses. What's inside
packs a punch too!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: You'd better not get carried away, bro... The job's not over yet.
rows.display_text:
（You'd better not get carried away,
bro... The job's not over yet.）

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Do your best out there. I'll be cheering you on from right here.
rows.display_text:
「Do your best out there. I'll be cheering
you on from right here.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What's your deal...! What happened to that new machine you were bragging about?
rows.display_text:
「What's your deal...! What happened to
that new machine you bragged about?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I've got a much more fitting stage in mind for Beck the Great RX3's debut.
rows.display_text:
「I've got a much more fitting stage in
mind for Beck the Great RX3's debut.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Holding out on us, bro?
rows.display_text: 「Holding out on us, bro?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: A big shot knows how to pick his moment. Anyway, I'll leave the rest to you all.
rows.display_text:
「A big shot knows how to pick his
moment. Anyway, I'll leave the rest to
you all.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: ...It's time. The test is starting.
rows.display_text: 「...It's time. The test is starting.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Man, that's some serious climb rate!
rows.display_text: 「Man, that's some serious climb rate!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Looks like it's going to bomb from extremely high altitude.
rows.display_text:
「Looks like it's going to bomb from
extremely high altitude.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: What's wrong, Jerid?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Jerid?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: No... it's nothing.
rows.display_text: 「No... it's nothing.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Don't rush things, Lieutenant. For now, put everything you've got into the mission in front of you.
rows.display_text:
「Don't rush things, Lieutenant. For now,
put everything you've got into the
mission at hand.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: ...But, Commander... I...
rows.display_text: 「...But, Commander... I...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: You want to chase after $c?
rows.display_text: 「You want to chase after $c?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: ...I can't move forward until I beat that man. That's why...
rows.display_text:
「...I can't move forward until I beat
that man. That's why...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: So you're saying this is no place to be wasting time?
rows.display_text:
「So you're saying this is no place to be
wasting time?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Yes...

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: There is a way to make your wish come true, Lieutenant. It's...
rows.display_text:
「There is a way to make your wish come
true, Lieutenant. It's...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Commander! We're detecting a distortion in the dimensional boundary! It's at Orange's drop point!
rows.display_text:
「Commander! We're detecting a distortion
in the dimensional boundary, at Orange's
drop point!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: What!?
rows.display_text: 「What!?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Gah...!

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: What's wrong, Ensign Four!?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Ensign Four!?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: It was just a moment, but I had a headache...
rows.display_text:
「It was just a moment, but I had a
headache...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: What was that, just now...? Was it... someone's will?
rows.display_text:
（What was that, just now...? Was it...
someone's will?）

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: But I can't tell... It felt like it might've been one person, and also like it might've been more than one...
rows.display_text:
（But I can't tell... it felt like one
person, and also like it might've been
more than one...）

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Captain Dominic, what's happening with the dimensional boundary distortion!?
rows.display_text:
「Captain Dominic, what's happening with
the dimensional boundary distortion!?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: That's stabilized, but we've got a moving contact near the blast site!
rows.display_text:
「That's stabilized, but we've got a
moving contact near the blast site!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Did something just transfer in on a tiny space-time tremor!?
rows.display_text:
「Did something just transfer in on a
tiny space-time tremor!?」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: A group of contacts, closing in on us! Here they come!!
rows.display_text:
「A group of contacts, closing in on us!
Here they come!!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Wh-what the hell is that!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what the hell is that!?」

rows.speaker: Geraba
rows.en: It's a monster, boss! A monster showed up!!
rows.display_text:
「It's a monster, boss! A monster showed
up!!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: D-don't lose your nerve, Geraba! W-we're Special Task Force 013!
rows.display_text:
「D-don't lose your nerve, Geraba!
W-we're Special Task Force 013!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: That's a flashy monster! It's like the whole sky's turned into a rainbow!
rows.display_text:
「That's a flashy monster! It's like the
whole sky's turned into a rainbow!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: A rainbow-colored sky...
rows.display_text: （A rainbow-colored sky...）

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Butterfly wings... the end of the world...
rows.display_text:
（Butterfly wings... the end of the
world...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Is it... a Coralian...?
rows.display_text: 「Is it... a Coralian...?」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Captain Dominic...?
rows.display_text: 「Captain Dominic...?」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: What's the call, Commander? That Unknown... it looks like some kind of living creature.
rows.display_text:
「What's the call, Commander? That
Unknown looks like some kind of living
creature.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: That swarm... it looks like it's heading for the city behind us.
rows.display_text:
「That swarm... it looks like it's heading
for the city behind us.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Are they going to attack the city!?
rows.display_text: 「Are they going to attack the city!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: No response to our hails... And they clearly mean to engage, with a city right behind us...
rows.display_text:
「No hail response -- and they clearly
mean to engage, with a city right behind
us...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: No choice, then. We intercept...!
rows.display_text: 「No choice, then. We intercept...!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Seems we were called out here to deal with them, after all...!
rows.display_text:
（Seems we were called out here to deal
with them, after all...!）

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Tch...! My bad feeling went and came true!
rows.display_text:
「Tch...! My bad feeling went and came
true!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The enemy's strength is unknown...! Everyone, stay sharp!
rows.display_text:
「The enemy's strength is unknown...!
Everyone, stay sharp!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: If that's really a Coralian... then Orange is part of the Ageha Plan's...
rows.display_text:
（If that's really a Coralian... then
Orange is part of the Ageha Plan's...）

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Another swarm approaching! Same type of Unknown!
rows.display_text:
「Another swarm approaching! Same type
of Unknown!」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: You're kidding! There's still this many of them!?
rows.display_text:
「You're kidding! There's still this many
of them!?」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Those things... they're bottomless!
rows.display_text: 「Those things... they're bottomless!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Wait...! Something's wrong with them!
rows.display_text: 「Wait...! Something's wrong with them!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: It exploded...!?
rows.display_text: 「It exploded...!?」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Doesn't look like a self-destruct.
rows.display_text: 「Doesn't look like a self-destruct.」

rows.speaker: Jaboli
rows.en: A-anyway, we're saved...
rows.display_text: 「A-anyway, we're saved...」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: ...Something about that doesn't sit right.
rows.display_text:
「...Something about that doesn't sit
right.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Wait, does that mean we got called out here just to deal with those things?
rows.display_text:
「Wait, does that mean we got called out
here just to deal with those things?」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Then, the reason that monster showed up is...
rows.display_text:
「Then, the reason that monster showed
up is...」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: ...because Orange was dropped?
rows.display_text: 「...because Orange was dropped?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...All units, return to base. HQ's sent word that the operation is concluded.
rows.display_text:
「...All units, return to base. HQ's sent
word that the operation is concluded.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: We're getting a proper explanation for all this, right!?
rows.display_text:
「We're getting a proper explanation for
all this, right!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...Also, this operation has been given an AAA security classification.
rows.display_text:
「...Also, this operation has been given an
AAA security classification.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: AAA... the highest classification there is... So even those of us who took part are forbidden from asking questions about it...
rows.display_text:
「AAA... the highest classification there
is. Even we who took part are forbidden
from asking about it...」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: If that really was the Coralian they spoke of...
rows.display_text:
（If that really was the Coralian they
spoke of...）

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: I think it's safe to say Dewey Novak's plan has come quite far along.
rows.display_text:
（I think it's safe to say Dewey Novak's
plan has come quite far along.）

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Dominic...
rows.display_text: 「Dominic...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Anemone... our real fight is about to begin...
rows.display_text:
（Anemone... our real fight is about to
begin...）

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: ...I've had enough of this...
rows.display_text: 「...I've had enough of this...」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Jerid...
rows.display_text: 「Jerid...」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I've had enough of being treated like a pawn for the brass's convenience...! Just what is this unit, anyway!?
rows.display_text:
「I've had enough of being a pawn for
the brass's convenience...! Just what is
this unit, anyway!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Exterminating some unidentified monster, huh... We're being used way too conveniently.
rows.display_text:
「Exterminating some unknown monster,
huh... we're being used way too
conveniently.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Damn it! Order or not, they're valuing our lives way too cheap!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! Order or not, they're valuing
our lives way too cheap!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I'll do it...! No matter what we're up against, I'll survive!
rows.display_text:
「I'll do it...! No matter what we're up
against, I'll survive!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I refuse to die... not until I've beaten him -- Kamille Bidan!
rows.display_text:
「I refuse to die... not until I've beaten
him -- Kamille Bidan!」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Was what I felt just now really someone's will...?
rows.display_text:
（Was what I felt just now really
someone's will...?）

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: And if it was, does it have something to do with that monster...?
rows.display_text:
（And if it was, does it have something
to do with that monster...?）

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Come if you dare, you monster! Don't think you can bring down Asuham Boone so easily!
rows.display_text:
「Come if you dare, monster! Don't think
you can bring down Asuham Boone so
easily!」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: To see my ambition through, I will survive, no matter what!
rows.display_text:
「To see my ambition through, I will
survive, no matter what!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: If they're going to come at us in numbers, I'll knock them down one after another!
rows.display_text:
「If they come at us in numbers, I'll
knock them down one after another!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: I'm going for a high score!!
rows.display_text: 「I'm going for a high score!!」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: So that monster is the antibody mentioned in the Ageha Plan's records.
rows.display_text:
（So that monster is the antibody
mentioned in the Ageha Plan's records.）

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Most likely. Now that Dewey Novak has started moving, we'll need to hurry as well.
rows.display_text:
（Most likely. Now that Dewey Novak's on
the move, we'll need to hurry too.）

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Did Dr. Jie know this monster would appear...!?
rows.display_text:
「Did Dr. Jie know this monster would
appear...!?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Knowing the doctor, we should assume he was involved in developing Orange itself.
rows.display_text:
「Knowing the doctor, assume he was
involved in developing Orange itself.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Heh... the man never changes.
rows.display_text: 「Heh... the man never changes.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: If the doctor's research is nearing completion, then we need to hurry...!
rows.display_text:
「If the doctor's research is nearing
completion, then we need to hurry...!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Schlan! For the sake of our plan too, we're getting back alive, no matter what!
rows.display_text:
「Schlan! For our plan's sake too, we're
getting back alive, no matter what!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Our... plan, is it...
rows.display_text: （Our... plan, is it...）

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Tch! Of all things, Beck the Great RX3's big debut has to be against some creepy freak like this!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! Of all things, Beck the Great
RX3's debut has to be against some
creepy freak like this!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Here I come, monster! Take a good long taste of this masterpiece of mine, and carry it with you to the afterlife!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, monster! Take a good long
taste of my masterpiece, and carry it
with you to the afterlife!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Rainbow... sky... Gundam... Black History...
rows.display_text:
「Rainbow... sky... Gundam... Black
History...」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Wh-what is this...!? What's happening to me!?
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what is this...!? What's happening to
me!?」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Can't believe that bad feeling actually panned out...! Seems like sticking with these guys is just one raw deal after another!
rows.display_text:
「Can't believe that bad feeling panned
out...! Sticking with these guys is just
one raw deal after another!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: I won't have enough lives to spare at this rate...! I'd better seriously start thinking about getting out.
rows.display_text:
「I won't have lives enough to spare at
this rate...! I'd better seriously think
about getting out.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What is with those things!? Just looking at them makes me sick!
rows.display_text:
「What is with those things!? Just looking
at them makes me sick!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: I'll knock every last one of you down! It's your own fault for coming at us!
rows.display_text:
「I'll knock every last one of you down!
It's your own fault for coming at us!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...Where is Dr. Jie?
rows.display_text: 「...Where is Dr. Jie?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: He's using the base's facilities to modify Mr. Beck's machine.
rows.display_text:
「He's using the base's facilities to
modify Mr. Beck's machine.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Shoves the orders on us and then washes his hands of it, huh... A free spirit if there ever was one.
rows.display_text:
「Shoves the orders on us, then washes
his hands of it, huh... A free spirit if
there ever was one.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Guarding a new weapon's test... For a mission that's worth interrupting our BG pursuit, it must be quite an important test.
rows.display_text:
「Guarding a new weapon's test... A
mission worth interrupting our BG pursuit
must be quite important.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Who knows... But you'd better brace yourself, just in case.
rows.display_text:
「Who knows... But you'd better brace
yourself, just in case.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: What do you mean by that?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean by that?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The fact that this job landed on us is about as sure a sign as any that trouble's coming.
rows.display_text:
「That this job landed on us is about as
sure a sign as any that trouble's coming.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'd guess this resupply is meant to prepare us for a fight against whatever enemy shows up there.
rows.display_text:
「I'd guess this resupply is meant to
prep us for a fight against whatever
enemy shows up there.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: The orders don't say anything about the possibility of an enemy appearing?
rows.display_text:
「The orders don't say anything about
the possibility of an enemy appearing?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: You don't tell a test subject what the test is for.
rows.display_text:
「You don't tell a test subject what the
test is for.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Test subject...? You mean us?
rows.display_text: 「Test subject...? You mean us?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: So you believe Special Task Force 013 was formed for the purpose of an experiment, Commander?
rows.display_text:
「So you believe Special Task Force 013
was formed as an experiment, Commander?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: We run into enemies wherever we go, and on top of that, this unit's makeup is nothing a regular army would ever put together...
rows.display_text:
「We run into enemies everywhere, and on
top of that, this unit's makeup is nothing
a regular army would assemble...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: It's the only reasonable conclusion.
rows.display_text: 「It's the only reasonable conclusion.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Then what is this special mission to pursue BG?
rows.display_text:
「Then what is this special mission to
pursue BG?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Just a pretext for standing up the unit, I'd wager. It's even possible that target machine belongs to the military too.
rows.display_text:
「Just a pretext for standing up the
unit, I'd wager. That target machine might
belong to the military too.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: ...None of that matters, either way.
rows.display_text: 「...None of that matters, either way.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Captain Schlan...
rows.display_text: 「Captain Schlan...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: We're soldiers. When carrying out the orders we're given, there's no need to question their meaning.
rows.display_text:
「We're soldiers. Carrying out the orders
we're given, there's no need to question
their meaning.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: That may be so, Captain... but soldier or not, we're still human. A man wants to know the meaning behind his own actions, at least.
rows.display_text:
「Maybe so, Captain... but soldier or not,
we're human. We at least want to know
why we do it.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Is that so? In a chaotic world like this one, with no future in sight, seeking meaning is itself meaningless.
rows.display_text:
「Is that so? In a chaotic world with no
future in sight, seeking meaning is itself
meaningless.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: It's like some endless act of penance. I reject that sort of thing outright.
rows.display_text:
「It's like some endless act of penance. I
reject that sort of thing outright.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Schlan... you...
rows.display_text: 「Schlan... you...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: That was out of line of me to say. ...I have machine maintenance to attend to, so if you'll excuse me.
rows.display_text:
「That was out of line to say. ...I have
machine maintenance to attend to, if
you'll excuse me.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: I'll take my leave as well.
rows.display_text: 「I'll take my leave as well.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Seeking meaning is meaningless, is it... Might well be true...
rows.display_text:
「Seeking meaning is meaningless, is it...
Might well be true...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: If you think about it calmly, in a situation like this, it's no time for the Federation, PLANT, and Chiram to be at each other's throats...
rows.display_text:
「Calmly put, this is no time for the
Federation, PLANT, and Chiram to be at
each other's throats...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: And yet people never stop fighting... myself included, sensing something's wrong somewhere, but having no choice but to follow orders...
rows.display_text:
「And yet people never stop fighting...
myself included -- sensing wrongness, yet
having no choice but to follow orders.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: To stop thinking... that's practically the same as giving up on living.
rows.display_text:
「To stop thinking... that's practically
the same as giving up on living.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Excuse me.
rows.display_text: 「Excuse me.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Lt. Jerid, is it... Here with questions about the next operation?
rows.display_text:
「Lt. Jerid, is it... Here with questions
about the next operation?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Not just that. I'd like you to tell me about the meaning of this unit.
rows.display_text:
「Not just that. I'd like you to tell me
about the meaning of this unit.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: ...There's someone I absolutely have to beat. For that, I don't want to waste time on missions that lead nowhere.
rows.display_text:
「...There's someone I absolutely have to
beat. I don't want to waste time on
missions leading nowhere.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Please, Commander...!
rows.display_text: 「Please, Commander...!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Heh...

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: What's so funny...!?
rows.display_text: 「What's so funny...!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: No, forgive me...
rows.display_text: 「No, forgive me...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: It just pleases me that you have a reason to fight beyond simple orders from above, Lieutenant.
rows.display_text:
「It pleases me that you have a reason
to fight beyond simple orders from above,
Lieutenant.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: ...Huh.

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: We've got time before the next operation. If you don't mind, tell me about this person you want to beat.
rows.display_text:
「We've got time before the next op. If
you don't mind, tell me about this person
you want to beat.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Y-yes, sir...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes, sir...」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: There ya go, Beardy! All done!
rows.display_text: 「There ya go, Beardy! All done!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: This is the best, old man! You deserve to be called a genius!
rows.display_text:
「This is the best, old man! You deserve
to be called a genius!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Thank you, very macho!
rows.display_text: 「Thank you, very macho!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: What are those guys over there getting so worked up about?
rows.display_text:
「What are those guys over there getting
so worked up about?」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Word is he's won over Dr. Jie and built himself some new giant machine, using the military's facilities and materials.
rows.display_text:
「Word is he's won over Dr. Jie and built
some new giant machine, using the
military's facilities and materials.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Backed by the special task force's budget and privileges, he's doing whatever he pleases.
rows.display_text:
「Backed by the special task force's
budget and privileges, he does whatever
he pleases.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: That guy sure doesn't hold back. Seems like he's a cut above your average punk.
rows.display_text:
「That guy sure doesn't hold back. Seems
like he's a cut above your average punk.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I heard that, mister. Calling me a punk, are you?
rows.display_text:
「I heard that, mister. Calling me a punk,
are you?」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Oops... my apologies if that rubbed you the wrong way. But believe it or not, I meant it as a compliment.
rows.display_text:
「Oops... apologies if that rubbed you
wrong. But believe it or not, I meant it
as a compliment.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Eh, forget it. I'm a professional too... I've got no interest in stirring up petty trouble with the people who hired me.
rows.display_text:
「Eh, forget it. I'm a pro too... no
interest in stirring up petty trouble with
the people who hired me.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Same goes for me. Heh... seems you understand how things work, kid.
rows.display_text:
「Same goes for me. Heh... seems you
understand how things work, kid.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Thanks, mister. Well... this'll probably be a short partnership, but let's get along.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks, mister. Well... this'll probably
be a short partnership, but let's get
along.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Beck. Remember, I'm the one who recommended you -- my own standing is on the line here too. Don't let me down.
rows.display_text:
「Beck. I'm the one who recommended you
-- my own standing's on the line too.
Don't let me down.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Yeah, yeah, I know. I'll show you all what this new power of mine can do on our next sortie.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, yeah, I know. I'll show you all
what this new power of mine can do next
sortie.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: I've been issued a Golem myself. I intend to perform even better than before.
rows.display_text:
「I've been issued a Golem myself. I
intend to perform even better than
before.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Careful there, boys. When the higher-ups get generous, there's usually a catch to it.
rows.display_text:
「Careful there, boys. When the
higher-ups get generous, there's usually a
catch to it.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: What do you mean by that, Special Advisor?
rows.display_text:
「What do you mean by that, Special
Advisor?」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: This Special Task Force 013 reeks of something fishy, if you ask me. My gut's telling me it's bad news.
rows.display_text:
「This Special Task Force 013 reeks of
something fishy. My gut's telling me it's
bad news.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Hmph...
rows.display_text: 「Hmph...」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Well... just don't go and get yourself killed. You can't afford to end things before you settle your score with the Black Southern Cross, right?
rows.display_text:
「Well... don't get yourself killed. Can't
end things before settling your score
with the Black Southern Cross, right?」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Quite right. I'll take that warning to heart, gladly.
rows.display_text:
「Quite right. I'll take that warning to
heart, gladly.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Doesn't matter much to me either way. If things get too dicey, I'll just cut and run.
rows.display_text:
（Doesn't matter much to me either way.
If things get too dicey, I'll just cut and
run.）

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Well... with a lineup like this, we shouldn't have any trouble even against a real monster of an opponent.
rows.display_text:
（Well... with a lineup like this, we
shouldn't have trouble even against a real
monster of an opponent.）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Dr. Jie, do you know anything about the new weapon we're guarding?
rows.display_text:
「Dr. Jie, do you know anything about the
new weapon we're guarding?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Sure thing. I'm a genius, so I know everything, nya~.
rows.display_text:
「Sure thing. I'm a genius, so I know
everything, nya~.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Then please, tell me the details.
rows.display_text: 「Then please, tell me the details.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: I refuse...!
rows.display_text: 「I refuse...!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: 'Cause if I told you, it wouldn't be a secret weapon anymore, nyan.
rows.display_text:
「'Cause if I told you, it wouldn't be a
secret weapon anymore, nyan.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Just leave him be, Dominic. This old geezer's definitely just faking like he knows something.
rows.display_text:
「Just leave him be, Dominic. This old
geezer's definitely just faking like he
knows something.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Wh-what!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what!?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Are you psychic, little lady, nya? If so, why don't you peek a little deeper into this old geezer's head, nya.
rows.display_text:
「Psychic, are you, little lady, nya? Then
peek a little deeper into this old
geezer's head, nya.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Don't come any closer, you creep!
rows.display_text: 「Don't come any closer, you creep!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Don't touch Anemone! Get out of here!
rows.display_text: 「Don't touch Anemone! Get out of here!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: More! Give me more of that ice-cold attitude! More anger! More contempt!
rows.display_text:
「More! Give me more of that ice-cold
attitude! More anger! More contempt!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: D-doctor... do you really not know anything at all about the new weapon?
rows.display_text:
「D-doctor... do you really not know
anything at all about the new weapon?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Hmmm... well, if it's a request from cute little Dominic, I suppose it can't be helped.
rows.display_text:
「Hmmm... well, if it's a request from
cute little Dominic, I suppose it can't be
helped.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: All right, I'll tell you just a bit, so lend me your ear, nya.
rows.display_text:
「All right, I'll tell you just a bit, so
lend me your ear, nya.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Y-yes, sir...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes, sir...」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Fwooooo...
rows.display_text: 「Fwooooo...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Aaaaaaaaaah!! It's warm and wet!!
rows.display_text: 「Aaaaaaaaaah!! It's warm and wet!!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: A total success!
rows.display_text: 「A total success!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: He just blew in his ear...!?
rows.display_text: 「He just blew in his ear...!?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Ugh, I can't stand it! What is with this guy!?
rows.display_text:
「Ugh, I can't stand it! What is with this
guy!?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Ah... aah... aaah...
rows.display_text: 「Ah... aah... aaah...」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Sorry 'bout that, little Dominic. As an apology, I'll tell you a little bit about the new weapon, nya.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry 'bout that, little Dominic. As an
apology, I'll tell you a bit about the new
weapon, nya.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: So lend me your ear.
rows.display_text: 「So lend me your ear.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Dominic! Don't fall for the same trick twice!
rows.display_text:
「Dominic! Don't fall for the same trick
twice!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Oh, you caught me?
rows.display_text: 「Oh, you caught me?」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: That's enough out of you. I'll stomp you flat with my Dominator!
rows.display_text:
「That's enough out of you. I'll stomp
you flat with my Dominator!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Well, if that's how it is, I suppose I have no choice. Very well, I shall grant you the secret.
rows.display_text:
「Well, if that's how it is, I've got no
choice. Very well, I'll grant you the
secret.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: The new weapon... its name is... Orange.
rows.display_text: 「The new weapon... its name is... Orange.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Orange...?
rows.display_text: 「Orange...?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: That's as far as I can tell you, nya. The rest, you'll have to find out for yourselves.
rows.display_text:
「That's as far as I can tell you, nya.
The rest, you'll have to find out for
yourselves.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Were we... called here just to take down that monster?
rows.display_text:
「Were we... called here just to take
down that monster?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Anemone...!
rows.display_text: 「Anemone...!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: The last mission was classified AAA. Even among those of us who took part, discussing it is forbidden.
rows.display_text:
「The last mission was AAA classified.
Even those of us who took part are
forbidden to discuss it.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Like I care about that! Are you... planning to rat us out!?
rows.display_text:
「Like I care about that! Are you...
planning to rat us out!?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Well now... what should I do, I wonder...?
rows.display_text:
「Well now... what should I do, I
wonder...?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: I've had it...! Being used like this, whenever it's convenient for them!
rows.display_text:
「I've had it...! Being used like this,
whenever it's convenient for them!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I've reached my limit too... I want to hear exactly what the higher-ups intend to do with us.
rows.display_text:
「I've reached my limit too... I want to
know exactly what the higher-ups intend
for us.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: They're right, Commander. If we're going to keep being jerked around for the brass's convenience, then our cooperation ends here.
rows.display_text:
「They're right, Commander. Keep jerking
us around for the brass's convenience,
and our cooperation ends here.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Seeking meaning is meaningless... is it. But at least the people here haven't given up on living. Not yet.
rows.display_text:
（Seeking meaning is meaningless... is it.
At least the people here haven't given up
on living. Not yet.）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Myself included.
rows.display_text: （Myself included.）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: ...Commander. We've received a transmission from HQ.
rows.display_text:
「...Commander. We've received a
transmission from HQ.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: They say they've located BG, our target.
rows.display_text:
「They say they've located BG, our
target.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...You heard it, everyone. We're moving out to pursue BG.
rows.display_text:
「...You heard it, everyone. We're moving
out to pursue BG.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Commander...! Are you just going to ignore our questions!?
rows.display_text:
「Commander...! Are you just going to
ignore our questions!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Lieutenant... do you remember what I was about to say during the operation?
rows.display_text:
「Lieutenant... do you remember what I
was about to say during the operation?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: You mean, the way to make my wish come true?
rows.display_text:
「You mean, the way to make my wish
come true?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: That's right. And there's only one way to do it...
rows.display_text:
「That's right. And there's only one way
to do it...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Terminate Special Mission Code 013.
rows.display_text: 「Terminate Special Mission Code 013.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Special Mission Code 013...
rows.display_text: 「Special Mission Code 013...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: We're a special task force. Complete that mission, and the unit will be disbanded.
rows.display_text:
「We're a special task force. Complete
that mission, and the unit will be
disbanded.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: ...Understood.
rows.display_text: 「...Understood.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: My goal is to chase down $c. To do that, I'll bring this unit to an end.
rows.display_text:
「My goal is to chase down $c. To do
that, I'll bring this unit to an end.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: I'm all for it~! A unit this messed up ought to be disbanded as soon as possible.
rows.display_text:
「I'm all for it~! A unit this messed up
ought to be disbanded as soon as
possible.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Once the unit's disbanded, my contract's fulfilled too, and I'll be saying my goodbyes.
rows.display_text:
「Once the unit's disbanded, my
contract's fulfilled too, and I'll be saying
my goodbyes.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Hey... if that happens, we get to go back to Master Kizz's place, right?
rows.display_text:
「Hey... if that happens, we get to go
back to Master Kizz's place, right?」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Quite right, Lady Cynthia. I too will finally be able to pursue the Black Southern Cross.
rows.display_text:
「Quite right, Lady Cynthia. I too can
finally pursue the Black Southern Cross.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: This unit really has become quite unpopular, hasn't it?
rows.display_text:
「This unit really has become quite
unpopular, hasn't it?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: No kidding... But then again, maybe this is the first time everyone's will has come together as one.
rows.display_text:
「No kidding... but maybe this is the
first time everyone's will has come
together as one.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Notice to all hands, once again: we will continue pursuing BG as planned.
rows.display_text:
「Notice to all hands, once again: we
will continue pursuing BG as planned.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: To finally bring Special Task Force 013 to an end, we will accomplish our mission at the next contact, no matter what...!
rows.display_text:
「To finally end Special Task Force 013,
we'll accomplish our mission at the next
contact, no matter what...!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: A rainbow-colored sky... the end of the world...
rows.display_text:
「A rainbow-colored sky... the end of the
world...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: What's with you, bro? Is that some kind of poetry?
rows.display_text:
「What's with you, bro? Is that some kind
of poetry?」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Black History... Gundam... a great power...
rows.display_text:
「Black History... Gundam... a great
power...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: H-hey... what's gotten into you? Did fighting that monster rattle a screw loose in your head?
rows.display_text:
「H-hey... what's gotten into you? Did
that monster rattle a screw loose in your
head?」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: It's terrifying... oh, it's so terrifying...
rows.display_text:
「It's terrifying... oh, it's so
terrifying...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Get a grip, bro! Word is the next one's gonna be a real do-or-die fight.
rows.display_text:
「Get a grip, bro! Word is the next one's
gonna be a real do-or-die fight.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Once the job's done and the bonus comes in, let's go somewhere and live it up.
rows.display_text:
「Once the job's done and the bonus
comes in, let's go somewhere and live it
up.」
